quality_formula: geometric mean of clipped [sqrt(area)/250, LaplacianVariance/150, grayStdDev/50] (each clipped 0.05..1), multiplied by retained bbox area fraction
preprocessing: grayscale CLAHE clipLimit=2 tileGridSize=(8,8); cubic 3x; unsharp Gaussian sigma1 weight1.3/-0.3
ocr: EasyOCR en; CRAFT + english_g2; CPU full precision quantize=False to match original GPU precision path; readtext digits allowlist detail1 paragraphFalse defaults
aggregation: team roster filters only; per frame/candidate maximum OCR confidence across variants; sum confidence*(0.5+0.5*quality); best must have >=2 distinct accepted frames, share>=0.60 and normalized margin>=0.20; deterministic ties ascending jersey; otherwise None
inference_inputs: original video + filtered MOT + frozen team assignment and roster only; baseline jersey used only in reporting
evaluation_gate: persist all automatic outputs before inspecting diagnostic target; downstream only if target automatic jersey is 6; no tuning
